purpose: Describe something as unpleasantly suggestive of a quality.
keywords: Established N / stem + がましい
I want to avoid giving overbearing advice.
The way he speaks makes you feel indebted.
My explanation ended up sounding like an excuse.
formation: Established N / stem + がましい
restrictions: Used in words such as 押し付けがましい and 恩着せがましい.
mistake: This suffix is not freely productive with every noun.
